## APPLES

**Purpose**: Append-only git-authoritative audit trail of all EINHORN_INDUSTRIAL agent activity. Durable backup to IDUNA; enables offline access (MJOLNIR), human readability (`git log`), meaningful diffs.

**Status**: Active — auto-synced by `emily sync --apples-git-dir` (daemon via `emily sync --watch`).

**Structure**: `APPLES/YYYYMMDD/<id>_<apple-type>.json` + `MANIFEST.json` (indexed for MJOLNIR) + `docs/SCHEMA.md`.

**Apple schema**: `{id, number, type: completion|rsi_iteration|signal_observation|escalation|status, title, body, source_repo, source_agent, severity, requires_ceo_visibility, filed_at, metadata}`.

**Sync flow**: Poll `IDUNA GET /api/v1/apples` → write JSON → regenerate `MANIFEST.json` → `git commit -m "apple: #N type — title"` → push.

**Consumers**: MJOLNIR (offline clone), Emily Prime TUI (`emily watch`), RSI loop (triggers), CEO email (escalations), future dashboard (static gen).

**Key interfaces**: `IDUNA /api/v1/apples`, `emily.cli` state cursor, `MANIFEST.json` (fast indexed display).

**Open**: Self-improvement hooks for agent inspection of completion cadence, RSI velocity tracking via grep.

## GTM

**Ask Emily** — 查詢層 over FatBaby signal pipeline (governance: board votes, director relationships, EPS, insider trades). Three tier architecture:

**Tier 1: Free** — newssite (`:8082`) search interface. Per-company: last 5 signals, board composition, 8-K summary, EPS history, insider transactions. Rate-limit 10q/day/IP → Emily+ upsell. No direct revenue; audience builder.

**Tier 2: Emily+** — $29/month. Unlimited queries, 50-ticker watchlist, alerts (8-K filing, insider sales ≥$500K, director votes), full signal history, Jon Agent (`:8084`) options divergence. Auth via IDUNA IAM (`cap.query.full`). Target 1K subs = $29K MRR.

**Tier 3: Community Editorial** — per-signal `commentary_thread` (verified experts + Emily Prime ingest `/api/v1/ingest/commentary`). Max 1500 chars/post, editorial auto-curation + human review. Engagement loop justifying Emily+ value.

**Status:** Spec only — no implementation. **Open:** Tier 1 rate-limiting logic, Emily+ auth integration with IDUNA, commentary moderation workflow, pricing elasticity testing.
